title: Nigeria Telecom Data Quality Audit: Reproducible ISO/IEC 25012 Assessment and TR-DQGF
description: Version 1.0.0 reproducibility package for a standards-based audit of Nigerian public telecommunications workbooks covering Q2 2024 to Q4 2025. The package contains the final V3 Python audit script, methodological metadata, machine-readable derived audit outputs, and documentation accompanying the manuscript 'Auditing Public Telecommunications Data Quality in Nigeria: A Reproducible ISO/IEC 25012 Assessment and DAMA-DMBOK-Informed Governance Framework'. The study proposes the Telecom Regulatory Data Quality Governance Framework (TR-DQGF).
